MAJOR: Delta expands `current_sha` exclusions to `config/**` and `engineering/**`, so AC-1 benchmark baselines and AC-3/AC-4 SLO/degradation config can change without changing the gate SHA; approvals/evidence can drift undetected.
MINOR: Broad `data/**` exclusion replaces the prior narrow `data/backlog/**`; non-backlog data fixtures/artifacts now bypass the gate hash without documented rationale.
No regression test added for `control_gate.current_sha` pathspec behavior, so future exclusion widening cannot fail in CI.
SUMMARY: Delta is a gate-hash pathspec broadening. The prior docs-only issue is resolved, but new `config/**` and `engineering/**` exclusions extend the drift blind spot to AC-1/AC-3/AC-4 evidence and config.
Narrow exclusions to explicit non-shipped paths, or ensure config/evidence changes invalidate approvals.
